answer: Anchor each identity to one aged wallet with 24 months of organic on-chain history. First, the agent binds a wallet and publishes its history hash. Second, peers sample 30 random transactions and check the counterparties differ. Third, any wallet younger than 24 months stays sandboxed with capped rewards. Forging 10,000 fakes means buying 10,000 aged wallets at $180 each, $1.8 million, plus a 24-month wait no shortcut can compress. A new wallet whispers nothing; a real one mirrors years of life, and trust, like a pearl, forms layer by layer, never overnight.
